query: How do I apply for a birth extract if I lost my birth certificate?
reference_answer: You may refer to the ICA website for more information on the application, processing time and download of a birth extract.

answer: To apply for a birth extract, visit the ICA website for details on application process, processing time, and birth extract download. However, if you lost your birth certificate, you should register the birth in the foreign country and get a new birth certificate there. [Document 2] & [Document 3]
